author: fabiocos
body:
#### PR description:

This PR fixes the issue https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52431#issuecomment-6867836944 reported by @makortel . The recent integration of #51861 has not properly updated the MTD sequences concerning premixing in stage2, and this is causing failures in #52278 . The event content and configurations are here updated so as to run smoothly premixing tests.

#### PR validation:

Wf. 38634.99 runs smoothly (using a few self-made MinBias events for PU).
title: MTD reconstruction and validation: fix of MTD sequences for premix2 after SoA local reco
